text:
linda: Midday async — quick check: kernel micro-op refactor landed in #4923, rolling canary. Any regressions?

alex: Saw CPU pins on canary in us-west1, p95 spiked ~30ms after warmup. digging.

priya: PR review incoming for batching API (PR #4950). Left one comment about `max_batch_tokens`.

jamal: KV cache eviction tuning pushed — changed max_entries=200k -> 300k on canary, eviction rate dropped.

sasha: Bench run just finished against canary: 1k requests, seq=512, p50=41ms, p95=89ms, tokens/sec improved ~12%. logfile: https://internal/bench/181450

alex: repro steps for the p95 spike: run `make bench SEQ=256 CONC=8`. added logs to the canary pod.

priya: I saw a flaky test in `kernel_op_test` on CI, failing on fp16 reduction. Marked flaky @jamal can you take?

jamal: taking it. suspect rounding under quantized path, will add a deterministic seed.

linda: thanks. @bench-bot can we schedule a 5k-run overnight and keep traces?

bench-bot: scheduled perf-run id=brun-2026-03-16-01 (5k requests, seq=512). results will post morning.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout at 30% now. Auto-fallback tracked.

sasha: small ask — anyone reviewed my docs update for `kv-hotcache` eviction metrics? link: https://docs.internal/redwood/kv-evict

priya: I'll take a pass after lunch.

linda: Blockers: none critical. Follow-ups: alex + jamal on kernel test + p95; priya + sasha on docs + batching API review. Ping here when done. :thumbsup:
